Persistent bias: Beverages — agree whether a family-level correction is justified.
In simulation, a rule-based bias-correction override changed holdout WAPE from 12.57 % to 13.02 % (FVA -0.45 pp). Keep overrides for information the model does not have and record a reason code.
13 series have planned promotions above their historical 95th percentile; confirm those promotion plans before accepting their forecasts.

fva.label: Simulated, rule-based override, not human-planner performance
fva.rule: For each holdout origin T and family, the champion's bias is measured over all completed windows before T (calibration windows and earlier holdout windows with origin + 14 days ≤ T). If |bias| > 2 %, the simulated planner divides that family's forecasts by (1 + bias/100); otherwise the forecast is kept. fva_pp = champion WAPE − simulated WAPE (positive = the rule reduced error).

scale: index (series training-period mean = 100); 14-day values = mean daily value over the 14 days / series base x 100
notes: stat_index = the champion 14-day forecast as an index: mean daily forecast over the 14 days ÷ the series' mean daily sales in the training period before the first selection origin (2015-06-01 to 2017-02-06) × 100, so 100 = an average training-period day. p10_index / p90_index = the frozen 14-day-total P10–P90 band on the same scale.

Per-series units are not published (Kaggle competition rules: raw competition data is not redistributed). Converting an index back to units needs the series base, which only someone with the competition data can compute locally (scripts/08_export_dashboard.py, src/indexing.py).
